items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stump I think I probably met after I left and came back – started to come back.

ctx.x: Shirley. He was one of the better drummers that she had, because she used to sing so slow that nobody could keep that slow a pulse. But him and the bass player had it down, where they was perfect for her. Lewis – the bass player’s name was Lewis something. I can’t think of it.
Maybe that was it, Lewis Powell. Stump and Lewis Powell and her was perfect. Stump I think I probably met after I left and came back – started to come back.
